theorems.name: Submission.ltg_tau_unique_on_open
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U O : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen O → O ⊆ U → ∀ (M₁ M₂ : Set (Eucl P)) (θ₁ θ₂ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ₁ ξ₂ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) k), IsRectifiableTriple U k M₁ θ₁ ξ₁ → IsRectifiableTriple U k M₂ θ₂ ξ₂ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) ⊆ O → tauAction k M₁ θ₁ ξ₁ ω = tauAction k M₂ θ₂ ξ₂ ω) → (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)) (symmDiff M₁ M₂ ∩ O) = 0 ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict (M₁ ∩ O)), θ₁ x = θ₂ x ∧ ξ₁ x = ξ₂ x
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
